runtime: Ollama v0.40.1 (user-level, models on the external drive)
notes: Tags and sizes come from ollama.com/library on 2026-10-09. Options switch thinking off for every model that supports it (Ollama enables thinking by default for Gemma 4 too), so all models answer in the same latency class; gpt-oss cannot switch reasoning off and runs at its lowest effort. Run `fedeval.py check` before a long run.

models.name: qwen3.5-9b
models.role: Newest small Qwen; the main candidate for researchers' 12 GB GPUs

models.name: qwen3.5-4b
models.role: Size ladder within Qwen3.5; the laptop-class floor

models.name: gemma4-12b
models.role: A second family at the same size class

models.name: gemma4-e4b
models.role: Small Gemma, to compare with qwen3.5:4b

models.name: ministral3-14b
models.role: European vendor at the largest size that fits fully on the GPU

models.name: granite4.2-8b
models.role: Enterprise model that advertises JSON output and Chinese support

models.name: lfm2.5-8b

models.name: qwen3.6-35b-a3b

not_compared.name: nimble, tev1, clef-flash
not_compared.why: Decision models: they choose among supplied answers through /v1/systemone, cannot write the plan's nested JSON, and accept only 2-8k tokens. Candidates for a separate pre-classifier (supported or not, safe or not).

not_compared.name: muse-glimmer:30b
not_compared.why: Meta's Apache-2.0 agent model (18 GB); architecture undisclosed, so likely dense and slow here. Add later if a server tier is evaluated.

not_compared.name: granite4.2:30b, qwen3.5:27b, qwen3.6:27b, gemma4:31b
not_compared.why: Dense 27-31B models run mostly on the CPU here; qwen3.8:27b represents this class.

not_compared.name: kimi-k3, glm-5.3, deepseek-v4-pro, mistral-large-4, qwen3.5:122b
not_compared.why: Server-class (80 GB to over 600 GB at 4-bit).
